$comment: Single source of truth for every model-baked vLLM GPU image published to
into its build matrix; the consuming workflows read one entry each through
These pins MUST stay single-sourced. resolve-vllm-gpu-image decides whether
a consumer can reuse the published image by comparing the image's provenance
labels against the model and revision it was asked for, so a consumer that
carried its own copy of a pin would silently rebuild from source every run
Default image. Qwen3-8B is the model the full GPU Responses suite and the
Claude Code / Codex acceptance jobs qualify against: the 0.6B CPU model
cannot drive reliable tool calling. The 8.19B bf16 checkpoint is ~15.3 GiB
and fits the g5.xlarge A10G (24 GiB) with room for a KV cache.
Deliberately unpinned by revision, matching how the suite has always
served it; set `revision` to freeze it.
Vision companion. A separate model is required because Qwen3-8B above is
text-only. Revision-pinned so the nightly compares image requests against
fixed weights. Served without tool-call or reasoning parsers: those are
text-model specific and the vision tests do not drive tool use.
